newsitem.title: UK: Biocompatibles climbs on newspaper stock tip.
newsitem.headline: Biocompatibles climbs on newspaper stock tip.

text.p: Shares in Biocompatibles International rose sharply on Thursday, benefiting from a newspaper stock tip, although trading volume remained thin.
The shares were 32-1/2p higher, up almost four percent, at 852-1/2p by 1018 GMT, after 37,000 shares had changed hands.

Shares in the biotech company were tipped in the Daily Mail newspaper Thursday. The newspaper said analysts at Kleinwort Benson were expecting earnings per share to double "each year, well into the next century".
